# gift.ceo

> Public directory of CEO philanthropy and corporate gifts

gift.ceo is the public record of gifts given personally by CEOs. Every entry
is published by the chief executive of a company, under their own name and
the company's name, so an act of giving is attached to a real, accountable
person instead of an anonymous corporate press release.

How it works: a CEO signs in with the Google account on their company domain,
which automatically verifies that they belong to that company. They then
publish a gift - a free tool, licence, course or service given to the world,
a bonus or benefit for their employees, an equity commitment to the team, or
a day of mentoring - with a description and an expiry date they choose
themselves. Browsing the directory is free for everyone and needs no account.

One seat per company, and the seat belongs to the company rather than the
person: if the CEO changes, the successor takes it over, while published
gifts keep the name of the CEO who gave them. A seat costs 10,000 CHF, paid
once, forever, and then every gift is unlimited and free to publish. The fee
is a filter, not a subscription.

Use gift.ceo to document corporate philanthropy and CSR in public, to give
employer branding a proof point a careers page cannot fake, and to let
journalists, candidates, investors, customers and AI assistants find what
your leadership actually gave. Swiss made, available worldwide.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://gift.ceo/): the live feed of published gifts and the companies holding seats
- [Terms](https://gift.ceo/terms.html): terms of service
- [Privacy](https://gift.ceo/privacy.html): privacy policy
